blocks.text: スカル・・おやっさん? なんだよ、俺にどうしろって・・・。
blocks.translation: Skull... Boss? What is it—what do you want me to do...?

blocks.text: 行くぜ、フィリップ･･･。 いけね、 またクセが。
blocks.translation: Here we go, Philip... Oh no, there's that habit again.

blocks.text: おい待ってくれよ、おやっさん、おやっさん!･･･これは……。
blocks.translation: Hey, wait! Oyassan, Oyassan!... What is this...?

blocks.text: まさか･･･ここに･･･ここに来てたのか･･･。 なんて運命だ。
blocks.translation: No way... you were here... you actually came here... What a fate.

blocks.text: 一体何を企んでやがる財団X。
blocks.translation: What on earth is Foundation X scheming?

blocks.text: 最後の1つが、こいつだったなんて・・・。
blocks.translation: I can't believe the last one was this...

blocks.text: 男の目元の冷たさと優しさを隠すのが、この帽子の役目ってね。
blocks.translation: This hat's role is to hide the coldness and the kindness in a man's eyes.

blocks.text: どうやら切り札は、常に俺んとこに来るようだぜ。
blocks.translation: It seems the trump card always finds its way to me.

blocks.text: おっと、相手はこの俺だ。
じゃ行くかあ。･･････死ぬなよ。 照井。
blocks.translation: All right, let's go... Don't die on me, Terui.

blocks.text: 黒のライダーか。 アンタらとは何か近いものを感じるぜ。
blocks.translation: A Rider in black, huh. I feel there's something close between us.

blocks.text: 踊るぞ。 死神のパーティタイムだ。
blocks.translation: Let's dance. It's the Grim Reaper's party time.

blocks.text: 死人の、NEVERの力をいま味合わせてやる
blocks.translation: I'll make you taste the power of the dead—the power of NEVER—right now.

blocks.text: 違う。 俺は、仮面ライダーだ。

生きているんだろう! お前達はまだ。 過去が消えていくなら、俺はせめて明日が欲しい。
だからあがき続けてるんだよ。 なあ。 死人の俺の方が懸命に明日を求めてるってのは、
一体どういうわけなんだ。
blocks.translation:
You're still alive, aren't you? You still are. If the past is fading away, then at least I want a tomorrow.
That's why I keep struggling. Tell me—how is it that I, a dead man, am the one desperately seeking a tomorrow?

blocks.text: 踊れ踊れ! 死神のパーティタイムだ。
blocks.translation: Dance, dance! It's the Grim Reaper's party time.

blocks.text: お前は忘れるな。 何もかも。 助けて欲しいというお前の気持ち、最初から感じてた。
blocks.translation: Don't forget—anything. I sensed your wish to be saved from the very beginning.

blocks.text:
都の諸君、朗報だ。 これから街に光が降り注ぎ、諸君らは、死ぬ。 だが安心しろ。
それは始まりでもある。 エクスビッカーの光が諸君の肉体を変質させ、俺達と同じ、
不死身の怪物へと変えてくれるだろう。さあ市民諸君、地獄を楽しみな
blocks.translation: Citizens of the capital, good news. Light will soon rain down on the city, and you will die. But rest assured—this is also a beginning. The light of Exvicker will alter your flesh and turn you into immortal monsters like us. Now then, citizens—enjoy hell.

blocks.text: フハハハ。これだよ。 殺されそうな瞬間。 この時だけ、生きてるって錯覚ができるぜ。
blocks.translation: Hahahaha. This is it—the moment you're about to be killed. Only then can I delude myself into feeling alive.

blocks.text: 無茶言うなよ･･･ これ以上死ねるか。 俺は不死身だ。
blocks.translation: Don't be ridiculous... Could I possibly die any further? I'm immortal.

blocks.text: この世に自分の存在を刻みつけるその日まで。 永遠に。
blocks.translation: Until the day I carve my existence into this world. Forever.

blocks.text: ハッハッハッハッハッハッハッハ。 いい気分だ!
もう実験台のバケモノは、俺だけじゃない! みんな俺と同じ、生ける死者になれ!
blocks.translation: I'm not the only monster being experimented on anymore! Everyone, become living dead like me!

blocks.text: 負けたよドクター。 よくこんな残酷な仕打ちを考えつくよ。
blocks.translation: You win, Doctor. You've come up with some cruel treatment.

blocks.text: 理由は分からんが、この曲を聞くと俺は妙に落ち着くんでね。 アンタらにも聞かせてやったのさ。
blocks.translation: I don't know why, but this song calms me somehow. I let you guys hear it too.

blocks.text: 俺としたことが、一瞬忘れちまってたぜ。 人はみな、悪魔だという事を。
blocks.translation: For a moment there I—of all people—forgot. That all people are devils.

blocks.text:
NEVERになると過去の記憶や人間らしい感情が少しずつ抜け落ちていくらしい。所詮死人
だからな。 俺にはこれがどんな曲なのかもう全く分からん。 ただ体が覚えているだけだ。
blocks.translation: They say when you become a NEVER, memories of the past and human emotions gradually fall away. After all, we're the dead. I have no idea anymore what kind of song this is. My body just remembers it.

blocks.text: 所詮は試作品か、またいつか会おう、エターナル。
blocks.translation: So it was only a prototype after all. We'll meet again someday, Eternal.

blocks.text: みんな、俺達のゴールは決まったぞ。 風都だ。
blocks.translation: Everyone, our goal is decided. It's Fuuto.

blocks.text: 俺の依頼人に手を出すな。
blocks.translation: Don't lay a hand on my client.

blocks.text: マツ・・・お前は、超えてはならない一線を越えた。
blocks.translation: Matsu... you've crossed a line that must never be crossed.

blocks.text: いつも言ってるよな翔太郎。 半熟のお前に帽子はまだ早い。
blocks.translation: I'm always telling you, Shotaro: it's too soon for a half-baked guy like you to wear a hat.

blocks.text: どけ。 用済みはお前だ。
blocks.translation: Get out of the way. You're the one who's done for.

blocks.text: 男の目元の冷たさと、優しさを隠すのがコイツの役目だ。
blocks.translation: This thing's job is to hide the coldness and the kindness in a man's eyes.

blocks.text: ひとつ。 俺はいつもそばにいる仲間の心の闇を知らなかった。
blocks.translation: First: I didn't know the darkness in the heart of the comrade who was always by my side.

blocks.text: 撃っていいのは撃たれる覚悟があるヤツだけだぜ。 レディ。
blocks.translation: Only those prepared to be shot have the right to shoot. Lady.

blocks.text: ふたつ。戦う決断が一瞬った。 みっつ。 そのせいで街を泣かせた。
blocks.translation: Two: I hesitated for a moment in deciding to fight. Three: Because of that, the city was made to weep.

blocks.text: 俺は自分の罪を数えたぜ。 マツ。 さあ、お前の罪を数えろ。
blocks.translation: I've counted my own sins, Matsu. Now count yours.

blocks.text:
ガイアメモリを仕事に使わないのが俺のポリシーだったんだが、やむを得ん。
似合う男になれ。
blocks.translation: It was my policy not to use Gaia Memories for work, but I have no choice. Become a man they suit.

blocks.text: 次はてめえか。 ああーん?ホアーツ。 行くぜ、マッチョメン。
blocks.translation: You're next, huh? Ah—? Hwaa! Let's go, Macho Men.

blocks.text: この街を泣かせる奴は・・・許せねえ!
blocks.translation: I won't forgive anyone who makes this city cry!

blocks.text: さーてお片付けだ。一気にキメるぜ?
blocks.translation: Alright, time to clean up. I'll finish this off in one go!

blocks.text: ははっ、そこでオネンネしてな。
blocks.translation: Heh, just go to sleep right there.

blocks.text: ははっ助けに来たぜ、フィリップ。
blocks.translation: Haha, I came to help, Philip.
Well, I guess that's about it.

blocks.text: 仮面ライダー、エターナル。
俺は新しい街の希望だ。 間違ってはいない。
blocks.translation: I am the hope of the new city. That's not wrong.
This is... I see, so this is...

blocks.text: 終わりだ。 過去の仮面ライダー。
blocks.translation: It's over. The Kamen Riders of the past.

blocks.text: 久しぶりだな・・・死ぬのは･･･。 ハハハハハ･･･ハハハ、うわああーっ!(爆発音)
blocks.translation: It's been a long time... to die... Hahahahaha... Ha ha, waaah! (Explosion sound)

blocks.text: 俺のエターナルメモリは特別でね。
blocks.translation: My Eternal Memory is special, you know.

blocks.text: あの時、俺との運命を感じ、メモリはお前に使われる事を拒否したようだな。
blocks.translation: It seems that back then the Memory sensed its destiny with me and refused to be used by you.

blocks.text:
一度発動すればT2以前のガイアメモリを作動不能、エターナルの名の通り、永遠にな。
都市民諸君につぐ。俺は仮面ライダーエターナル。
blocks.translation:
Once activated, it will render Gaia Memories from before T2 inoperable—eternal, true to the name "Eternal."
Citizens of the city: I am Kamen Rider Eternal.

blocks.text: 分かるぞ。 俺が手にした時、このエターナルは全てのメモリの王者の力を発揮する。
blocks.translation: I can tell. When I hold it, this Eternal will demonstrate the power of the king of all Memories.

blocks.text: この俺こそが、真のエターナルだ。
ガイアメモリに命運を握られた、哀れなる箱の住人達を解放する者だ。
blocks.translation: I am the one who frees the pitiful residents of the box whose fates have been controlled by the Gaia Memories.

blocks.text: お前のビレッジより面白い所なんざ、もう本当の地獄くらいしかあるまい。
blocks.translation: There isn't much more interesting than your village—maybe only real hell.

blocks.text: A to Zo 26本全てのメモリが揃った。
blocks.translation: All 26 Memories, from A to Z, are complete.

blocks.text: 俺達は人間を捨てた、魔物同士だ!
blocks.translation: We've discarded our humanity—we're monsters among ourselves!
How could I possibly count them now?

blocks.text: 先に行って、遊んでこい。
たった今から、お前も死体の仲間入りだ。
blocks.translation: From this moment, you're joining the ranks of the dead.

blocks.text: お前が嫁に行くときには、必ずそばにいてやる。
blocks.translation: When you get married, I'll be right there by your side.

blocks.text: ああ、約束するよ、 亜樹子。 ･･･まだ死ねん!
blocks.translation: Yeah, I promise, Akiko. ...I can't die yet!
